rationale: All lenses and standards ran; 8 blocking findings: missing Alembic migration for new effort columns, effort not carried through the virtual-assistant router and the versioning/compare/migration services, dial catalog still carrying reasoning: true (spec AC9), plus 1 open decision on dial effort declarations (confidence low) and a code-quality annotation violation. 14 lens claims dismissed as unreachable, speculative or below the floor (ChatAnthropic effort field verified present); 0 deferred. Brief and fix-pack sidecars written.

business_review.item: AC1: effort accepts exactly low|medium|high|xhigh|max on every DTO carrying temperature and on WorkflowAssistant
business_review.notes: Literal field added on all DTOs and WorkflowAssistant; invalid value rejected at construction (tested)

business_review.item: AC2: LLMFeatures().effort is None; clamp_effort_level clamps down only
business_review.notes: Default None and clamp helper tested

business_review.item: AC3: enterprise path sends clamped reasoning_effort; unset gets no key
AC4: direct Anthropic ChatAnthropic receives clamped effort, never xhigh
AC5: Bedrock additional_model_request_fields carries clamped output_config.effort
AC6: claude-4-5-haiku and claude-4-5-sonnet never gain effort
business_review.notes: No declaration in AWS or dial catalogs; exclusion test present

business_review.item: AC7: dynamic detection derives features.effort from supports_output_config plus xhigh/max flags
AC8: features.temperature False when supports_sampling_params is False
AC9: azure o3/o4-mini reasoning:true replaced by effort; no reasoning key remains in config/llms
business_review.notes: Azure converted; llm-dial-config.yaml still has reasoning: true at lines 120, 141, 162

business_review.item: AC10: effort reaches both agent classes through LLMParams and get_llm_by_credentials
business_review.notes: AIToolsAgent, LangGraphAgent, build_chat_model_for, get_llm_by_credentials; tests added

business_review.item: AC11: build_agent passes assistant.effort; workflow override semantics
business_review.notes: Service wiring and tests ok; persisted effort columns have no Alembic migration

business_review.item: AC12: no-effort requests and unsupported models produce unchanged request kwargs
business_review.notes: reasoning_effort popped when clamp is None; Anthropic/Bedrock add nothing

standards_review.notes: all 7 subjects in the review range match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format
Types And Imports rule prefers X | None and parameterized generics; new effort code uses Optional[str], Optional[list] and a bare list parameter (llm_config.py:63, enterprise/litellm/models.py:98).
no credential logging, hardcoded keys or unvalidated input; effort constrained by Literal and clamped against the model's declared ceiling

findings.title: Dial catalog still declares reasoning: true
findings.problem: Spec AC9 requires that no `reasoning` key remains in config/llms. Only llm-azure-config.yaml was converted; llm-dial-config.yaml still carries `reasoning: true` for o1, o3-2025-04-16 and o4-mini-2025-04-16 (lines 120, 141, 162).
findings.impact: Required spec criterion unmet; the key is no longer a field on LLMFeatures, so it is dead configuration that contradicts the migration to effort.
findings.recommendation: Remove `reasoning: true` at lines 120, 141, 162 (replace with effort levels where the model supports them) so no `reasoning` key remains under config/llms.

findings.title: Dial catalog omits effort for Claude entries
findings.problem: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-5-20251101 and claude-opus-4-6-20260205 declare features.effort in llm-aws-config.yaml (lines 37-38, 68-69, 83-84) but the same base_names in llm-dial-config.yaml (lines 194, 220, 233) declare none.
findings.impact: Those dial catalog entries silently yield no effort support. May be intentional if the dial path cannot forward effort, but the spec does not say so.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether the dial entries should declare the same effort levels (sonnet-4-6 and opus-4-6 [low,medium,high,max], opus-4-5 [low,medium,high]) or document that the dial path cannot forward effort.

findings.title: New effort annotations violate Types And Imports guide
findings.problem: code-quality.md Types And Imports prefers `X | None` and parameterized generics. clamp_effort_level declares `requested: Optional[str]` and `allowed: Optional[list]` (bare list); the same Optional pattern is added in enterprise/litellm/models.py:98 and in new effort parameters across llm_factory.py, dependecies.py, assistant_agent.py and langgraph_agent.py. Ruff config does not select UP rules, so no gate catches it.
findings.impact: Documented blocking code-quality standard violated by new code.
findings.recommendation: Annotate as `str | None` and `list[str] | None` (`list[Literal[...]] | None` for the field), and use `X | None` for the new effort parameters.

findings.title: No Alembic migration for new effort columns
findings.problem: AssistantBase.effort (assistants table, line 671) and AssistantConfiguration.effort (assistant_configurations table, line 1275) are new persisted String columns. Grep of src/external/alembic finds no migration mentioning effort (188 existing migrations; every earlier assistant column got one).
findings.impact: On an Alembic-upgraded database, assistant SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE reference a nonexistent column, so assistant reads and writes fail at runtime. No test exercises the schema.
findings.recommendation: Add an Alembic migration under src/external/alembic/versions with op.add_column('assistants', sa.Column('effort', sa.String(), nullable=True)) and the same for 'assistant_configurations', with a downgrade.

findings.title: Virtual assistant request effort is dropped
findings.problem: VirtualAssistantChatRequest.effort is added, but the virtual-assistant inference route builds Assistant.model_construct(...) copying temperature and top_p (around lines 1040-1041) and not effort. Grep confirms no effort reference in this router.
findings.impact: The new request field is accepted and validated but silently ignored; virtual-assistant callers always run with default effort.
findings.recommendation: Add effort=request.effort to the Assistant.model_construct call beside temperature/top_p and cover it with a router test.

findings.title: Version compare ignores effort
findings.problem: The change-detection candidate dict lists temperature and top_p but not effort; grep finds no effort in this service.
findings.impact: A partial update changing only effort is treated as no change, so no new version is created for it.
findings.recommendation: Add 'effort': request.effort to the candidate dict and test that an effort-only change reports has_changes.

findings.title: Initial-version migration drops effort
findings.problem: Assistant-to-AssistantConfiguration migration copies top_p (around lines 77, 112, 140) but not effort; grep finds no effort in this service.
findings.impact: Migrated initial version configs lose the assistant's effort; later restore yields None.
findings.recommendation: Copy effort=assistant.effort wherever AssistantConfiguration is built from Assistant, beside top_p.

findings.title: Versioning create/rollback/apply drop effort
findings.problem: create_initial_version, create_new_version, rollback_to_version and update_assistant_config_fields (lines 63, 121, 286, 332) copy temperature and top_p but not effort; grep finds no effort in this service.
findings.impact: Version snapshots always store effort as NULL; rollback does not restore effort, so version history and live assistant disagree.
findings.recommendation: Add effort=request.effort / versioned('effort') / effort=target_config.effort / assistant.effort = config.effort at those sites, with create and rollback tests.
